1444: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("UserSwapBaseAtkDef",
1445:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
1446:     # No flip-flopping
1447:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if user.effects[PBEffects::PowerTrick]
1448:     # Check stats
1449:     user_atk = user.base_stat(:ATTACK)
1450:     user_def = user.base_stat(:DEFENSE)
1451:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if user_atk == user_def
1452:     # NOTE: Prefer to raise Attack regardless of the drop to Defense. Only
1453:     #       prefer to raise Defense if Attack is useless.
1454:     if user_def > user_atk   # Attack will be raised
1455:       next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if !ai.stat_raise_worthwhile?(user, :ATTACK, true)
1456:       score += (40 * ((user_def.to_f / user_atk) - 1)).to_i
1457:       score += 5 if !ai.stat_drop_worthwhile?(user, :DEFENSE, true)   # No downside
1458:     else   # Defense will be raised
1459:       next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if !ai.stat_raise_worthwhile?(user, :DEFENSE, true)
1460:       # Don't want to lower user's Attack if it can make use of it
1461:       next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if ai.stat_drop_worthwhile?(user, :ATTACK, true)
1462:       score += (40 * ((user_atk.to_f / user_def) - 1)).to_i
1463:     end
1464:     next score
1465:   }
1466: )

1509:       # User's Attack will be lowered, target's Attack will be raised
